Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               With necessary diagram, obtain an expression for angle of acceptance and numerical aperture for an optical fiber.               (5)

1B)               A 0.50 kg baseball is confined between two rigid walls of a stadium that can be modeled as a "box" of length 100 m.             (3)

  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

2A)               Write the assumptions made in Planck's hypothesis of blackbody radiation. How Planck's law succeeds in explaining the           (5)  
  short and long wavelength regions of radiation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2B)               A 30-eV electron is incident on a square barrier of height 40 eV. What is the probability that the electron tunnels through the (3)

  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

  oscillator.

  calculate the moment of inertia and bond-length of the molecule.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
